question: In the Indian federal structure, which list includes subjects on which both the centre and states can legislate?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Concurrent List**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Concurrent List** is one of the three legislative lists defined under the **Seventh Schedule** of the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• This list includes subjects on which both the **Centre** and the **States** can legislate.
 
• It represents the concept of **cooperative federalism**, enabling joint efforts by both levels of government.
